title: macos-setup.sh: Fix autoconf update fallout
description:
On macos 15.3 the following fixes where required to build
the new autoconf stuff:
- New pcre2 version was not used everywhere (hardcoded 10.39)
- m4 was rejected as too buggy/old. Install the newest version.

Install FALCO-LIBS while we are at it.

Oh, and if there is breakage regarding some locales in 15.3, fix your locale settings.
